_comment: CCV-L23's declared feedback for ooe_rs (OA's ruling on OI-72, rev 205): the confirmation lead's loop. cf_en, the confirmation leads (OI-58, OI-61), is registered from the stage-02 state, so it is stage 03; the state registers' clock enable reads it back with that state in the next cycle. Each read's offset is the stages its tag lies past its reader's.

fl_cq01h.why: the state registers' clock enable: an entry confirming at this edge, its lead registered from the state at the last (OA's response OI-72, rev 205)
